note: XXV cues 105–131 fills · Booth style · Varna 25–26 Oct 1893
style: An oil painting in colour of 1893 with the drama of Franklin Booth: monumental scale, deep recession, towering forms, strong value contrast and deep shadow, shafts of light through haze, a sense of awe. Loose visible brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges. No text, signature or border.

beats.text: Shot: very wide. In the fifteenth century, a Wallachian army crossing the great river Danube into Turkish lands at dawn: armoured horsemen and banners on rafts and in the shallows, a vast grey river, smoke over the far bank, towering clouds. History painting.

Shot: far. A lone armoured horseman in a dark cloak riding away from a smoking battlefield across a wide plain toward a dark forest and mountains, fifteenth century, a vast stormy sky, his figure small. History painting.
Shot: very wide. A dark castle on a towering crag above endless forested Carpathian mountains, mist in the valleys, a pale sky with great clouds, no people.

Shot: close, no people. On a hotel table by a window, an 1890s map of the lower Danube and the Black Sea coast spread open, Varna and Galatz marked in red ink, a pencil, a Bradshaw railway guide, a cold shaft of daylight across it.

Shot: far interior. A high hotel room in Varna by day, 1893: a portable typewriter on a writing table by a tall window over the harbour, a stack of typed pages and a manuscript beside it, the room in deep shadow, no people.

Shot: very wide. The Danube at the river port of Galatz, Romania, in 1893 on a grey late-October day: a wide brown river, wharves and warehouses, a three-masted ship coming upriver out of thinning fog, church domes on the low bank.
